Introduction

Jung Yong Joo, also known as Nicole, is a South Korean rapper, dancer, singer, and actress. She is best known for being the main rapper, main dancer, and vocalist of the girl group KARA under RBW.

Nicole made her solo debut with the mini album, “First Romance” on November 19, 2014.

On January 13, 2014, Nicole left KARA after her contract expiration. But on September 19, 2022, it was announced that KARA would be releasing an album under RBW to commemorate the 15th anniversary of their debut with Nicole ultimately rejoining the group.

On February 18 2025, Nicole signed an exclusive contract with Inkode Entertainment, the agency founded by Kim Jae Joong.
